data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: SKILL.md carries an explicit top-level anti-redundancy directive requiring (a) semantic check of prior turns (paraphrase, negative signals) and (b) codebase check via Grep/Read/Glob before forming any question. Duplicate questions prohibited.
- DD2: Probe suppression rule — when prior answers cover UX probe topics, corresponding probes are skipped.
- DD3: Unit tests passing.

## Implementation Steps

Insert the following block into `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` immediately after the existing `<HARD-GATE>...</HARD-GATE>` block (currently ending on line 18):

```
<ANTI-REDUNDANCY-GATE>
Before forming any question — across all phases — you MUST:

1. **Semantic duplicate check**: Review all prior conversation turns. Do NOT ask any question whose answer was already given, including answers expressed through paraphrase, negative signals ("I told you", "I answered that"), or semantically-equivalent rewordings of prior responses.

2. **Codebase check**: Before asking a question whose answer may live in the repo, use Read, Grep, or Glob to look first. Only ask if the answer is not discoverable from code.

3. **Probe suppression**: When a prior user answer covers one of the UX probe topics (criticality — interaction criticality; non_happy_path — non-happy-path state coverage; flow_entry_exit — flow entry/exit points), skip that probe. Do not re-ask what the user has already addressed.

**Duplicate questions are prohibited.**
</ANTI-REDUNDANCY-GATE>
```

## Files to Modify
- `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md` — insert `<ANTI-REDUNDANCY-GATE>` block after existing `<HARD-GATE>` block

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SKILL.md contains `<ANTI-REDUNDANCY-GATE>` block at top level (before Phase 1)
  Verify: grep -q 'ANTI-REDUNDANCY-GATE' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md documents semantic duplicate check with negative signal examples
  Verify: grep -qiE 'I told you|I answered that|paraphrase|negative signal' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md documents codebase check (Read, Grep, or Glob)
  Verify: grep -qiE 'Read.*Grep.*Glob|Grep.*Read.*Glob|Glob.*Read.*Grep' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md documents probe suppression rule
  Verify: grep -qiE 'suppress.*probe|probe.*suppress|skip.*probe|probe.*skip' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] test-brainstorm-anti-redundancy.sh exits 0 (GREEN)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-anti-redundancy.sh
- [ ] test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh exits 0 (regression check)
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-progressive-validation.sh
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
